title: Polish the flip and cursor handoff
acceptance:
**Story or goal** · Keep the card readable and its target stable throughout the turn.

**Expected behaviour** · Compare Solid and Glass mid-flip. Remove background bleed, text jitter and shelf movement. Keep the outline on the stable face until actions are ready.

**Scope boundary** · Support an immediate face change under reduced motion and as a fallback for an unreliable flip.

**Previous in delivery queue** · WI-044

**Depends on** · WI-024, WI-030, WI-034, WI-044

**Verify** · Capture intermediate frames on a busy background. Replay rapid reversals, repeat input and a disappearing target.

**Effort basis** · Visual judgement and intermediate-frame verification.
